explanation: `IsKilledByIdealPower` is defined by the library itself (`∃ n, Module.IsTorsionBySet R M (I ^ n)`, in AdicModules/BoundedIdealPowerTorsion.lean); Mathlib has no declaration of that name. The theorem says a finite product is killed by some power of I exactly when every factor is. Its proof combines the library's own pi lemma, `Finite.exists_le` (to bound finitely many exponents by one) and the library lemma `isTorsionBySet_ideal_pow_of_le`. No single Mathlib declaration states this. The finiteness argument has some substance, so it is not a one- or two-line instantiation of a Mathlib lemma either.
